seo.title: Maison Aster | Apartments for Rent in Millbrook Commons, Toronto
seo.description: Studio to three-bedroom rental suites from $2,050/month, with a rooftop terrace, fitness studio and pet spa, 4 minutes from Millbrook Station. Book a tour.

hero.subline: Studio to three-bedroom rentals, from $2,050 a month.

summary: Maison Aster is a 312-suite rental building at 120 Aster Lane in Toronto’s Millbrook Commons, with studios to three-bedroom penthouses from $2,050 a month.

philosophy.quote: “A home should be the easiest part of your life.”
philosophy.label: (Philosophy)
philosophy.statement: Renting should feel like owning, without the hassle. We pair condo-quality homes with on-site service and a neighbourhood worth walking.

items.heading: Four minutes to everything
items.body: Millbrook Station, the ravine trail and the Commons market are all within a short walk. Downtown is 15 minutes by subway.

items.heading: Suites with room to breathe
items.body: Nine-foot ceilings, floor-to-ceiling windows and in-suite laundry. Ten floorplans, from 420 sq ft studios to a 1,350 sq ft penthouse.

items.heading: Eight spaces, all included
items.body: A rooftop terrace, fitness studio, co-working lounge and pet spa. No amenity fees, ever.

items.heading: Neighbours, not strangers
items.body: On-site management, 24/7 maintenance and a resident calendar of rooftop dinners, run club and movie nights.

slider.heading: Designed for the way you live
slider.body: Warm oak floors, quartz kitchens and daylight on three sides. Take a look inside.

cta.heading: A home, well kept. Come see it for yourself.
